<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#00000040"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="18" y="26" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">8:23</text>
    <rect x="318" y="15" width="10" height="10" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="332" y="13" width="10" height="12" rx="6" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="344" y="11" width="12" height="14" rx="7" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="362" cy="18" r="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <line x1="370" y1="18" x2="378" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="376" y1="14" x2="382" y2="14" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="376" y1="22" x2="382" y2="22" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="772" width="390" height="72" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="772" x2="390" y2="772" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>

  <g transform="translate(22,786)">
    <rect x="7" y="2" width="10" height="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#4F67C9">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(112,786)">
    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="17.5" y1="17.5" x2="23" y2="23" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Search</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(190,786)">
    <rect x="4" y="6" width="16" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="8" y1="6" x2="8" y2="3" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="16" y1="6" x2="16" y2="3" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Trips</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(270,786)">
    <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="6" y="16" width="12" height="8" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(338,786)">
    <rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="16" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="16" stroke="#525467" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="12" y="34" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#525467">More</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom sheet modal -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="192" width="390" height="652" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="0" y="192" width="390" height="652" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="246" x2="390" y2="246" stroke="#D6D6D6" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- top notch -->
    <rect x="24" y="202" width="134" height="5" rx="16" fill="#BDBDBD"/>
    <!-- header -->
    <text x="24" y="236" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="600" fill="#161C35">Travelers selector</text>
    <g transform="translate(348,220)">
      <circle cx="10" cy="10" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4F67C9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="6.5" y1="6.5" x2="13.5" y2="13.5" stroke="#4F67C9" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="13.5" y1="6.5" x2="6.5" y2="13.5" stroke="#4F67C9" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>

    <!-- room section -->
    <text x="24" y="278" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#161C35">Room 1</text>
    <text x="338" y="278" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#4F67C9">2 guests</text>

    <!-- Adults row -->
    <g>
      <rect x="16" y="292" width="358" height="78" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#F2F2F2"/>
      <text x="24" y="316" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#161C35">Adults</text>
      <text x="24" y="336" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">Ages 18 and above</text>

      <g transform="translate(248,306)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="36" height="36" rx="18" fill="#F2F2F2"/>
        <line x1="11" y1="18" x2="25" y2="18" stroke="#4F67C9" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      </g>
      <text x="303" y="329" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#161C35">2</text>
      <g transform="translate(314,306)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="36" height="36" rx="18" fill="#4F67C9"/>
        <line x1="11" y1="18" x2="25" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <line x1="18" y1="11" x2="18" y2="25" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Children row -->
    <g>
      <rect x="16" y="380" width="358" height="78" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#F2F2F2"/>
      <text x="24" y="404" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#161C35">Children</text>
      <text x="24" y="424" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">Ages 0 to 17</text>

      <g transform="translate(248,394)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="36" height="36" rx="18" fill="#F2F2F2"/>
        <line x1="11" y1="18" x2="25" y2="18" stroke="#4F67C9" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      </g>
      <text x="303" y="417" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#161C35">0</text>
      <g transform="translate(314,394)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="36" height="36" rx="18" fill="#4F67C9"/>
        <line x1="11" y1="18" x2="25" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <line x1="18" y1="11" x2="18" y2="25" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Add another room link -->
    <g>
      <line x1="24" y1="488" x2="372" y2="488" stroke="#F2F2F2" stroke-width="1"/>
      <line x1="26" y1="515" x2="38" y2="515" stroke="#4F67C9" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="32" y1="509" x2="32" y2="521" stroke="#4F67C9" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="46" y="519" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#4F67C9">Add another room</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Helpful booking summary -->
    <g>
      <rect x="16" y="540" width="358" height="102" rx="14" fill="#F2F2F2"/>
      <text x="28" y="566" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#161C35">Booking summary</text>
      <text x="28" y="590" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">1 room · 2 adults · 0 children</text>
      <text x="28" y="612" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">Free cancellation available on most stays</text>
      <text x="28" y="634" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">Prices may change after selection</text>
    </g>

    <!-- recommended room card list -->
    <g>
      <text x="24" y="678" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#161C35">Room setup suggestions</text>
      <text x="352" y="678" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#4F67C9">See all</text>

      <g>
        <rect x="16" y="692" width="358" height="48" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#F2F2F2"/>
        <circle cx="36" cy="716" r="14" fill="#4761C8"/>
        <text x="36" y="721" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">A</text>
        <text x="60" y="710" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#161C35">Standard room</text>
        <text x="60" y="728" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">Sleeps up to 3 · 1 queen bed</text>
        <text x="346" y="718" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#161C35">$149</text>
      </g>

      <g>
        <rect x="16" y="746" width="358" height="48" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#F2F2F2"/>
        <circle cx="36" cy="770" r="14" fill="#416D65"/>
        <text x="36" y="775" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">F</text>
        <text x="60" y="764" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#161C35">Family suite</text>
        <text x="60" y="782" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#525467">Sleeps up to 5 · sofa bed included</text>
        <text x="346" y="772" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#161C35">$219</text>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Done button -->
    <g transform="translate(31,804)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="328" height="48" rx="8" fill="#4F67C9"/>
      <text x="164" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Done</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
